posts.name: Wexiomatic
posts.cooked:
So  i've been doing analytical research into each of the sentinels heroes in order to try and create some in-depth guides for them,  and upon examining bunker I find myself giving a very serious look at the termination variant.  Now keep in mind I'm not a big bunker player but I at least understand how he functions and how his other base cards have their own strengths and weaknesses.  After playing a game or two and really looking at termination bunker, I don't really understand why he would be played. With two HP less then the base bunker and a power  that seems only to let you switch out two of your equipment cards with each other or situationally switch modes I don't understand how he's more  useful or unique than his other variants.

 

 I guess I want to ask what makes this card at unique and usable? Why would I want to use them over even the base bunker for already has a reputation for  having one of the least optimal face powers in the game?  I want to  create the best guides I can and I need to understand every variant of each character to do so so any advice or help on this variant you guys can offer would be appreciated.

posts.name: Bunston
posts.cooked:
It allows Bunker to cycle through his deck without forgoing his power phase, the caveat being you have to destroy a card. Consider this example:

 

Base Bunker

Play a card, use base power. Net result is 1 card in play, 2 cards drawn.

Termination Bunker

Play a card, use base power, play another card and use new power. Net result is 1 card in play, 2 cards drawn, and whatever the power was.

 

As you can see, Termination Bunker can accomplish more on his turns without sacrificing card draw, however his power has 3 caveats.

1. You end up with 1 less card in hand than Base Bunker

2. You have to be able to play a card with a power on it to fully utilize his base power.

3. You have to be wiling to sacrifice a card, but in my opinion Bunker has plenty of options for this.

 

He's not as good as hoarding cards for Gatling Gun and Omnicannon, but he is good at finding the cards you're looking for while still contributing to the fight.

posts.name: Dandolo
posts.cooked:
TermiNation Bunker can move through his deck to find damage dealing powers at the same speed as base Bunker. However, relative to base Bunker he effectively trades 1 card in hand for an extra power use.

Additionally, by letting you play, power, or draw in any order it allows Bunker to get the around the drawbacks of Mode cards.
